_comment: installer-managed - replaced on every install/update, so a local edit is lost. The ONE source of the context window (max input tokens) per model id for guard-stop-contract.js and guard-fresh-session-start.js; a model missing here takes ALFRED_CODE_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW. A key matches the id itself, a dated snapshot (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-opus-4-5@20251101), a Bedrock version (-v1:0), Claude Code's [1m] suffix and a provider-prefixed id (us.anthropic.claude-opus-5); the longest matching key wins. A point release never matches its sibling's key (claude-opus-5-5 is not a snapshot of claude-opus-5), so every model carries its own row. A model whose window is wrong here is fixed here, in the release.
